Docs.summary: Provides cookie interfaces, origin details, specification factories, and header names for the Apache HTTP client.

remarks.para: Use to parse response headers, validate cookies, match request targets, and format request headers. Parsing does not validate the returned cookies. Matching follows the selected cookie policy and does not replace validation or an expiration check.

Domain, path, and port restrictions depend on the selected specification. Under RFC 2965, port matching also checks the original Port attribute through . A stored port array alone does not establish that the server supplied this attribute.
These APIs bind the deprecated Java org.apache.http.cookie package. See the Android cookie source for the package declarations.
